relations.subject: Edmund Ronald Leach
relations.evidence: Leach was educated at Marlborough College and Clare College, Cambridge, where he graduated with a BA with honours in Engineering in 1932.

relations.subject: Edmund Ronald Leach
relations.evidence: After he left the Army in 1946, he returned to the London School of Economics to complete his dissertation under the supervision of Raymond Firth. In spring of 1947 he received a PhD in anthropology.
